Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI (2311.16502v1) · paper method: The MMMU study extracts answers using response-processing workflows; if no valid answer is found, it randomly selects an option for multiple-choice questions and marks open-ended responses incorrect.

MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI (2311.16502v1) · paper method: MMMU annotation guidance favors questions whose answers are less directly accessible, such as in separate documents or textbook endings, as a contamination-risk precaution.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI (2311.16502v1) · paper method: MMMU flags potential duplicates using lexical overlap and source-URL similarity, has authors review them, checks formatting and typos, and excludes questions classified as very easy.

MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI (2311.16502v1) · paper method: MMMU selects thirty subjects across six disciplines and recruits over fifty university students specializing in those majors to collect multimodal questions and create new questions where needed.
